```go
package http

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/v2/internal/artifact"
	"github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/v2/internal/testctx"
	"github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/v2/pkg/config"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestUploadRetries(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if calls.Add(1) <= 2 {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
			w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "0")
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	}))
	defer srv.Close()

	content := []byte("data")
	assetOpen = func(string, *artifact.Artifact) (*asset, error) {
		return &asset{ReadCloser: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(content)), Size: int64(len(content))}, nil
	}
	defer assetOpenReset()

	ctx := testctx.WrapWithCfg(t.Context(), config.Project{ProjectName: "blah"})
	ctx.Artifacts.Add(&artifact.Artifact{
		Name: "a.bin", Path: "a.bin", Type: artifact.UploadableBinary,
	})

	upload := config.Upload{
		Name: "test", Mode: ModeBinary, Target: srv.URL + "/{{.ProjectName}}/",
		Retry: config.Retry{Attempts: 3, Delay: time.Millisecond, MaxDelay: 10 * time.Millisecond},
	}
	err := Upload(ctx, []config.Upload{upload}, "upload", is2xx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int32(3), calls.Load())

	art := ctx.Artifacts.Filter(artifact.ByType(artifact.UploadableBinary)).List()[0]
	attempts := artifact.PublishAttempts(*art)
	require.Len(t, attempts, 3)
	require.Equal(t, "failure", attempts[0].Status)
	require.Equal(t, "failure", attempts[1].Status)
	require.Equal(t, "success", attempts[2].Status)
	require.Equal(t, "upload", attempts[0].Publisher)
	require.Equal(t, "test", attempts[0].Instance)
	require.Equal(t, srv.URL+"/blah/a.bin", attempts[0].Target)
}
```
